venue.title: Casa Bini
venue.intro: Our home for the weekend: a late-18th-century manor house on an organic farm near San Miniato, with olive groves, a pool and views over the hills. Everyone stays together under one roof, little ones too.
venue.altAerial: Aerial view of Casa Bini, its pool and the Tuscan hills at sunset
venue.altDining: Long dining table under brick arches at Casa Bini
venue.altBedroom: Bedroom at Casa Bini with terracotta floor and wooden beams
venue.altSunset: Casa Bini among the Tuscan hills at sunset
venue.altLiving: Living room at Casa Bini with a brick fireplace and big windows onto the garden

travel.title: Getting here
travel.intro: Casa Bini sits in the hills between Pisa and Florence. Tell us how you're arriving in your RSVP and we'll come and get you.
travel.mapLabel: Illustrated map: Casa Bini sits south-east of San Miniato, between Pisa airport to the west and Florence airport to the east, near San Miniato-Fucecchio and Granaiolo train stations.

psa.title: Pisa airport (PSA)
psa.text: We can pick you up. Car hire is also available at the airport.

flr.title: Florence airport (FLR)
flr.text: About 40–45 minutes by car. We can pick you up here too.

smf.title: San Miniato-Fucecchio station
smf.text: Direct trains from Pisa and Florence, about 30–40 minutes. We'll collect you from the station.

granaiolo.title: Granaiolo station
granaiolo.text: The closest station to the villa, about 13 minutes by car. Change at Empoli.

mainStations.title: Pisa Centrale or Florence S.M. Novella
mainStations.text: Coming by train from further away? We can pick you up from either main station too.

travel.carHire: Fancy exploring? A hire car is a great idea: Florence, Pisa, Lucca, Volterra and San Gimignano are all within easy reach.
